modes.title: Time Trial
modes.summary: Answer as many questions as you can on a 90-second clock. The clock only runs while a question is waiting for your answer.

scoring.summary: Your result is the number of questions you answer correctly before the clock runs out. It never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

modes.title: Survival
modes.summary: Keep answering until you make three mistakes. A wrong answer or a timeout costs a strike.

scoring.summary: Your result is the number of questions you answer correctly before your third strike. It never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

modes.title: Roster Lock
modes.summary: Rebuild a historical pro team: seat each of its five players in the lane they played.

scoring.summary: Each board scores 2 points only when all five players are in their own lanes; a partly right board scores nothing. A correct board locked strictly before the bot's earns 1 more. Unrated, so it never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

rules.heading: The match
rules.body: Three teams against a bot. You have 45 seconds for each board.

rules.heading: Your answer
rules.body: Ten players are dealt, starters and bench mixed together. Seat five in the Top, Jungle, Mid, Bot and Support positions, then Lock.

rules.heading: The reveal
rules.body: After each board, the real lineup is shown with the series it comes from.

modes.title: Draft Memory
modes.summary: Recall a historical pro draft: seat each of its five champions in the position it was played.

scoring.summary: Each board scores 2 points only when all five champions are in their own positions; a partly right board scores nothing. A correct board locked strictly before the bot's earns 1 more. Unrated, so it never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

rules.heading: The match
rules.body: Three drafts against a bot. You have 45 seconds for each board.

rules.heading: Your answer
rules.body: Ten champions are dealt. Seat the five this team played in the Top, Jungle, Mid, Bot and Support positions, then Lock.

rules.heading: The reveal
rules.body: After each board, the real draft is shown with the game it comes from.

modes.title: Chronoscope
modes.summary: Scrub a lane's timeline wave by wave and stop on the first wave where the stated condition comes true.

scoring.summary: Each objective scores 2 points only when you lock the exact first wave; any other wave scores nothing. A correct wave locked strictly before the bot's earns 1 more. Unrated, so it never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

rules.heading: The match
rules.body: Three objectives against a bot, such as the first wave where a duo laner reaches level 3. You have 30 seconds for each.

rules.heading: Your answer
rules.body: Scrub through the wave checkpoints. Each one shows the wave, the level after it and the lane's total XP. Lock the first wave where the objective is true.

rules.heading: The reveal
rules.body: After each objective, the correct wave and the XP that proves it are shown. Timing is to the wave, not the exact minion.

modes.title: Match Grid
modes.summary: Seat each rune under the rune tree it belongs to.

scoring.summary: Each board scores 2 points only when every rune is under its own tree; a partly right board scores nothing. A correct board locked strictly before the bot's earns 1 more. Unrated, so it never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

rules.heading: The match
rules.body: Three boards against a bot: 3 rune trees, then 4, then 5. You have 45 seconds for each board.

rules.heading: Your answer
rules.body: Seat every rune under a tree, then Lock. Many runes can share one tree.

rules.heading: The reveal
rules.body: After each board, every rune's real tree is shown.

modes.title: Reconstruct
modes.summary: Rebuild a legendary item's recipe from its components.

scoring.summary: Each recipe scores 2 points only when every component is right; a partly right recipe scores nothing. A correct recipe locked strictly before the bot's earns 1 more. Unrated, so it never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

rules.heading: The match
rules.body: Three legendary items against a bot. You have 30 seconds for each.

rules.heading: Your answer
rules.body: Fill every slot of the recipe from a tray of six components, then Lock. Where a slot sits doesn't matter, and a component the recipe needs twice goes in twice.

rules.heading: The reveal
rules.body: After each item, the real recipe is shown, with each component's own recipe beneath it.

modes.title: Order Forge
modes.summary: Put champions in order by a stat, then items by gold cost.

scoring.summary: Each order scores 2 points only when all five cards are in the right place; a partly right order scores nothing. A correct order locked strictly before the bot's earns 1 more. Unrated, so it never changes your Daily score or your Ranked rating.

rules.heading: The match
rules.body: Two boards against a bot: five champions by Health at level 18, then five items by gold cost. You have 30 seconds for each.

rules.heading: Your answer
rules.body: Drag the cards, or use the arrows, into the order the board asks for, then Lock.

rules.heading: The reveal
rules.body: After each board, the correct order is shown with every card's value.

modes.title: Rangefinder
modes.summary: Drag the target to an ability's exact cast range on the targeting board.

modes.title: Glyph Press
modes.summary: Complete a partially engraved champion, ability or item name.

modes.title: Perfect Timing
modes.summary: Time an ability's base cooldown with Start and Stop, with no number on screen.

modes.title: Stat Drop
modes.summary: Drop a marker where a historical stat lands on its scale.

modes.title: Combat Estimate
modes.summary: Set the two-beam balance to the damage one hit deals.
